description: Binary boundary term from precomputed signed ground-truth level set and foreground probabilities. Follows Kervadec et al., Section 2, Eqs. (3)-(5); the unit-grid sum is the discrete integral, while mean averages entries. Does not compute softmax or the distance map and excludes the regional term and alpha weighting (src/topologies/implementations/losses/boundary_loss.py:4-35).

examples.code:
import tempfile
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from topologies import Trainer, build, synth
root = tempfile.mkdtemp()
@synth.generator
def samples(ctx):
    image = torch.rand((1, 16, 16), generator=ctx.rng.torch)
    mask = torch.zeros((16, 16), dtype=torch.bool)
    mask[5:11, 5:11] = True
    outside = F.max_pool2d((~mask).float()[None, None], 3, stride=1, padding=1)[0, 0] > 0
    boundary = mask & outside
    rows, columns = torch.meshgrid(torch.arange(16), torch.arange(16), indexing="ij")
    points = torch.stack((rows, columns), dim=-1).reshape(-1, 2).float()
    boundary_points = points[boundary.reshape(-1)]
    distances = torch.cdist(points, boundary_points).min(dim=1).values.reshape(16, 16)
    signed_distance = torch.where(mask, -distances, distances).unsqueeze(0)
    return {"inputs": synth.Tensor(image), "distance": synth.Tensor(signed_distance)}
ds = synth.Spec("boundary-segmentation", generator=samples, size=8, splits={"train": 1.0}, seed=7, root=root, monitor="none").run()
train = ds.for_recipe("structured-objective", split="train")
class ForegroundModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.network = build("unet", "tiny", in_channels=1, out_channels=1, features=[4, 8])
    def forward(self, inputs):
        return {"probabilities": self.network(inputs).sigmoid()}
trainer = Trainer(ForegroundModel(), train, recipe="structured-objective", recipe_config={"loss": "boundary-loss", "bindings": {"logits_or_prediction": {"output": "probabilities"}, "targets": {"batch": "distance"}}}, batch_size=2, max_epochs=1, device="cpu")
trainer.fit()

name: Boundary loss for binary segmentation

parameters.additional parameters: unsupported; unrecognized keyword parameters raise ValueError
parameters.ignore_index: must be None because targets are continuous signed distances
parameters.logits_or_prediction: floating point foreground probabilities in [0, 1] with shape [B, 1, *spatial] and nonempty dimensions
parameters.reduction: none returns the elementwise product; sum computes the unit-grid discrete integral; mean averages all elements (default mean)
parameters.targets: finite floating point signed ground-truth distance map with the same shape, dtype, and device as probabilities
